payload.description: Implements story plx-21816d. Add a client-neutral CommandServiceStateStack under plexus/infrastructure/command_service. Provision a pk/sk DynamoDB table using on-demand billing, AWS-managed encryption, point-in-time recovery, deletion protection, and RETAIN; a standard SQS command queue with explicitly managed DLQ, encryption, retention, visibility, and redrive configuration; and a DLQ visibility alarm with optional operations-topic action. Expose stable resource attributes and outputs. Add CDK assertion tests, property validation, and a client-specific-value boundary scan. Do not add runtime adapters, Lambda, Fargate, API, dashboard, Celery, or legacy integration.
payload.title: Implement the reusable AWS command state stack
